setup.description: Creates CODEX save folder, writes LAN-ready config, randomizes player name

host.note: Listen server for up to 16 players. The menus and the readme say 8, but GameInfo takes ?MaxPlayers= up to 32 (checked with the server query on UDP 7778). Other game types: dnGame.dnDeathmatchGame_TeamDM, dnGame.dnKingOfTheHill, dnGame.dnCaptureTheBabe

join.note: Joins directly by IP over TcpNetDriver (no Steam lobby), so it works over the VPN

firewall: netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="DNF LAN" dir=in action=allow protocol=UDP localport=7777-7787,10707
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="DNF LAN" dir=in action=allow protocol=TCP localport=7777
